title: Structural basis of the RNA-editing cascade in trypanosome mitochondria.

verified.what_i_actually_checked: Searched RCSB PDB (Protein Data Bank) by this DOI: exactly 2 entries. 9DEI is RECC1 (the U-deletion editing complex), 2.99 Å, 11 polymer entities, 5,989 residues. 9Z0H is RECC2 (the U-insertion complex), 2.79 Å, 11 polymer entities, 5,032 residues. I read their metadata through the RCSB API but did not download the coordinate files. Europe PMC lists the paper as not open access with no PMCID. The PMC ID that NCBI links to (PMC13631411) belongs to a different paper, a Molecular Cell article on kinetoplastid mitochondrial assemblies.
verified.what_came_from_paper_text_only: From the abstract only: cryo-EM (cryo-electron microscopy) structures of the ~1-MDa RECC1 and RECC2 complexes, the roles of their domains, and the editosome model. No full text, supplement or data availability statement could be retrieved.

a1_downloadable.note: Two PDB entries (9DEI, 9Z0H) are public; I checked their metadata through the RCSB API. The EMDB (Electron Microscopy Data Bank) maps are presumably public too, but I did not open them.

a2_label_is_a_column.note: There is no label table. The output is two 3D atomic models, so any prediction target (for example editing sites or RNA-protein contacts) would have to be constructed from the structures or from other sources.

a3_inputs_present.note: The coordinates and chain sequences are in the PDB entries (metadata checked; files not downloaded).

a4_units_stated.note: Not applicable: structural coordinates are in standard units (Å).

a5_enough_rows.note: 2 complex structures with about 11 protein entities each, roughly 22 chains in total. That is far below the 400-1,500 labelled examples needed.

a6_fits_laptop.note: Tiny, but the rows don't exist anyway.

a7_counts_match_paper.note: The abstract describes two RECC structures, and PDB has 2 entries for this DOI.

a8_label_provenance.note: No label exists to trace. The structures themselves are experimental cryo-EM models, not predictions.

honest_claim_h3: No ML claim is possible: the data is two structures of macromolecular machines, not a set of labelled examples.

plain_idea.one_liner: Use protein chain sequences from trypanosome editing complexes to predict which residues contact the guide RNA-mRNA duplex.
plain_idea.train_on: Chains from 2 cryo-EM complexes, about 22 protein chains in total (entity counts from PDB metadata).
plain_idea.predict: Residue-level RNA contacts, which would have to be computed from the deposited coordinates rather than read from a measured column.
plain_idea.why_worthwhile: Of limited value: RNA-binding-residue predictors already exist, and 2 structures add almost nothing to the thousands of protein-RNA complexes already in PDB.

ml_idea: None viable. The deposited data is 2 cryo-EM structures (PDB entries 9DEI and 9Z0H). At most they could serve as a handful of test cases for structure predictors of RNA-protein complexes.

effort.compute_note: Not estimated, because the paper was rejected at Part A.
effort.cheapest_killing_check: Count the deposited entries: PDB returns 2 entries for this DOI, which fails A5 immediately.

verdict_reason: A structural biology paper with 2 PDB entries (9DEI, 9Z0H) and no tabular labelled data. It fails A2 (there is no label column) and A5 (2 structures). The existing-models search was skipped because Part A failed, so existing_models is empty because I didn't search, not because nothing was found.
